adapter_defects.defect: `config` is not a parameter of glmocr.api.GlmOcr.__init__ at v0.1.5. The signature is (config_path=None, *, api_key, api_url, model, mode, timeout, log_level, env_file, ocr_api_host, ocr_api_port, cuda_visible_devices, layout_device, **kwargs), and every keyword is forwarded verbatim into load_config, which drops names it does not know. The adapter's whole config dict -- maas off, ocr_api host/port, retry 0, task_prompt_mapping, layout model_dir -- was therefore discarded silently, leaving the shipped config.yaml's `pipeline.maas.enabled: true` in force. No TypeError is raised on that path, so the adapter's TypeError guard could never fire.
adapter_defects.fix: render sdk_config() to a YAML file and pass config_path=, which is the mechanism the SDK README's self-hosted section names, then read pipeline.maas.enabled, ocr_api.api_host/api_port/retry_max_attempts, layout.model_dir and page_loader.task_prompt_mapping back off GlmOcr.config_model and fail closed on any disagreement

adapter_defects.defect: inference_config pins the BAKED layout path /opt/arena/weights/pp_doclayoutv3_safetensors, and it is frozen and hashed so it cannot hold two. bootstrap.sh fetches the layout model to /workspace/arena/weights/pp_doclayoutv3_safetensors and exports ARENA_LAYOUT_DIR, but nothing read that variable: not the adapter, not arena/worker/config.py (which reads ARENA_WEIGHTS_DIR only). On a bootstrap pod adapter.load therefore failed with `layout model file model.safetensors is missing under /opt/arena/weights/...` right after hashing the 2.65 GB primary checkpoint -- the timing the 2026-09-03 18:39Z CRASHED matches.
adapter_defects.fix: adapter.resolve_layout_model_dir reads ARENA_LAYOUT_DIR and falls back to inference_config; entrypoint.sh exports the directory it just verified

adapter_defects.defect: glmocr passes layout.model_dir straight to from_pretrained, and its shipped default is the repo id PaddlePaddle/PP-DocLayoutV3_safetensors. A path that does not exist is read as a repo id and downloaded unpinned, which would silently replace a hashed Apache-2.0 checkpoint with whatever main holds.
adapter_defects.fix: the adapter refuses to construct the pipeline when the resolved layout directory does not exist, and entrypoint.sh exports HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 / TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 after both fetch steps and before the worker starts

adapter_defects.defect: dropped the pipeline reference without calling glmocr's own close(), leaving the SDK's worker threads behind.
adapter_defects.fix: OfficialSdkPipeline.close() calls the parser's close() and removes the rendered config file; GlmOcrAdapter.close() calls it

checked_and_correct: layout_device is a real keyword parameter of GlmOcr.__init__ at v0.1.5 and maps onto pipeline.layout.device; the adapter's use of it stands

the task_prompt_mapping keys the adapter pins (text/table/formula) are the three glmocr/config.yaml ships, and page_loader.build_request_from_image looks them up by exactly those names, so the D34 hash covers what the SDK actually sends

api_host/api_port/api_path/api_mode/model are OCRApiConfig fields, and ocr_client assembles http://{host}:{port}{path} when api_url is null, which is the local vLLM the entrypoint starts on 127.0.0.1:8080
retry_max_attempts is an OCRApiConfig field and 0 is inside its range; the SDK's own default is 2
PipelineResult exposes markdown_result and json_result, both of which the adapter already reads

vLLM 0.19.0 implements the architecture this checkpoint declares, and the MTP entry covers the --speculative-config mtp head the SDK README launches with. No newer vLLM is needed.

evidence.reading: vLLM 0.19.0's own GLM-OCR module names a transformers module that exists only in transformers >= 5.2.0. This is why the `< 5` bound above is treated as stale rather than binding.

evidence.fact: glmocr/layout/layout_detector.py imports, at module level: from transformers import PPDocLayoutV3ForObjectDetection, PPDocLayoutV3ImageProcessor

evidence.fact: transformers v5.3.0 ships src/transformers/models/pp_doclayout_v3/image_processing_pp_doclayout_v3_fast.py whose __all__ is ["PPDocLayoutV3ImageProcessorFast"]; modular_pp_doclayout_v3.py's __all__ names PPDocLayoutV3ImageProcessorFast and not PPDocLayoutV3ImageProcessor
evidence.reading: The vendor's own documented floor is not enough for the vendor's own code: at 5.3.0 `from transformers import PPDocLayoutV3ImageProcessor` cannot resolve. glmocr/layout/__init__.py catches that ImportError and defers it to Pipeline(), i.e. to the worker on a billed GPU, which is why this was invisible to the architecture preflight.
The slow slot is null, so there is no alias and no AutoImageProcessor path that would produce the un-suffixed name at 5.3.0. Confirms the line above rather than repeating it.

evidence.reading: 5.4.0 is the first release that exports the name glmocr imports, and it keeps model_type glm_ocr. v5.5.0, v5.6.0, v5.8.0 and v5.16.1 also carry the un-suffixed file, so 5.4.0 is the floor of the window, not a point fix.

that torchvision is actually installed in vllm/vllm-openai:v0.19.0-ubuntu2404 -- requirements/cuda.txt is the evidence, not an inspection of the published image. The import preflight is what turns a wrong assumption here into exit 64 before the weights are pulled.

that transformers 5.4.0's PPDocLayoutV3ImageProcessor loads the PaddlePaddle/PP-DocLayoutV3_safetensors checkpoint at revision 97d101e6 -- the class name resolves, which is all a static read can establish; whether its preprocessing matches what the SDK expects needs a pod

that no transformers newer than 5.4.0 would also work -- the window's upper bound was not walked release by release. 5.4.0 is the floor of the window and the smallest step from the pin the earlier pass reasoned to.

pins.install: python3 -m pip install --no-cache-dir --no-deps -- identical in runtimes/glm_ocr/bootstrap.sh and runtimes/glm_ocr/Dockerfile. wordfreq is the one pin installed WITH deps, because msgpack/langcodes/ftfy/locate are not in the image.
pins.rule: each pin is the oldest release that satisfies every proven requirement, and among those the newest that does not drag safetensors or tokenizers out from under vLLM. transformers 5.4.0 is a raised floor, not a preference: 5.3.0 is what the vendor names and it does not export the class glmocr imports.
